title: 电工实验规则与仪表
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/185_电工实验规则与仪表.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/185_电工实验规则与仪表/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在断电的电工实验台前，手里拿着电流表模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off electrical training bench holding a large analog meter model, the main switch off, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十三课：电工实验规则与仪表。

shots.scene: 阿杰想在通电时直接改一根线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches toward a wire terminal on a bench whose indicator lamp is lit, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰想趁通电，顺手改一根线。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator switches the bench off and raises a hand to stop him, a crossed out hand on a live terminal icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：通着电，绝不能改线！

shots.scene: 小研拿着电路图和仪表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank circuit diagram and an analog meter, nodding.
shots.narration: 小研：先懂规则和仪表，再动手。

shots.scene: 家里和工厂常用的电气设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of household and factory electrical equipment, a lamp, a fan, a motor and a switchboard. No text.
shots.narration: 电工实验，认识家里和工厂的电气设备。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a textbook with a lightbulb connected by an arrow to a hands on bench icon. No text.
shots.narration: 动手做一做，理论课也更好懂。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a path of steps from four meter icons to a numbered list of experiments. No text.
shots.narration: 先认识仪表设备，再一个个做实验。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety training badge before a bench icon, a lightning warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 做实验前，先学用电安全，通过准入。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase socket and a three phase supply icon with an electric shock warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 单相220伏、三相380伏，都能致命。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains a shock warning sign to a friend, both smiling.
shots.narration: 学会了，也给身边的人讲一讲。

shots.scene: 【实拍】实验台总开关处于断开位置
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a bench main switch in the off position and the indicator lamp dark.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger tracing each wire on a bench against a matching circuit diagram, check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 接完对照电路图，逐根检查一遍。

shots.scene: 老师查接线、量程、滑块、极性
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring on a powered off bench with a blank circuit diagram, the students waiting.
shots.narration: 请老师查接线、量程、滑块和极性。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teacher thumbs up icon unlocking a main switch handle. No text.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能合闸通电。

shots.scene: 要改线先断电，改完再查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loop of power off, rewire, teacher check, power on, a live rewiring hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 要改线：先断电，改完再请老师查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a distribution box with a padlock and a tag, a student hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 配电箱不自己开，检修上锁挂牌。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls out to her partners before switching on, both partners stepping back with hands away.
shots.narration: 合闸前提醒同组：要通电了！

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bench with all hands lifted away from the circuit, a check mark above the switch. No text.
shots.narration: 确认没人碰电路，再合闸。

shots.scene: 台面收干净，金属物远离端子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: spare wires, keys, coins and tools moved off a bench into a tray, terminals left clear. No text.
shots.narration: 多余导线、工具、钥匙硬币，全收走。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wires laid neatly along the bench, a taut hanging wire and a sleeve catching a wire crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 导线顺台面摆整齐，不绷紧不悬空。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two student icons at a bench and a teacher icon nearby, a single lone student crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 强电实验至少两人，老师在场。

shots.scene: 一人操作，一人守在总开关旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches a meter while the female graduate student stands with her hand near the main switch.
shots.narration: 一人操作，一人守在总开关旁监护。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person reading a meter with one hand, the other hand kept behind the back, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 通电读数尽量单手，另一手离开台面。

shots.scene: 先断实验开关，再断总电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two switches turned off in order, a small experiment switch first and then the bench main switch. No text.
shots.narration: 做完：先断实验开关，再断总电源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wires coiled and meters returned to a shelf, a clean bench. No text.
shots.narration: 最后拆线，器材归位。

shots.scene: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the room lights out, a hand switching the bench switch off, a timer showing power coming back. No text.
shots.narration: 突然停电，先断开实验台开关。

shots.scene: 来电后检查无误再合闸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lights back on, a checklist completed, then the bench switch turned on. No text.
shots.narration: 来电后，检查无误再重新合闸。

shots.scene: 冒烟、异味、发烫，立即断电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter with a small smoke wisp and a heat icon, a hand switching the bench off immediately. No text.
shots.narration: 冒烟、异味、发烫，立即断电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reporting to a teacher icon, a screwdriver opening a meter crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 报告老师，不自己拆表修理。

shots.scene: 有人触电，先断电再施救
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand hitting the emergency stop, a bare hand pulling a person crossed out, a phone showing 120. No text.
shots.narration: 有人触电先断电，不徒手拉，打120。

shots.scene: 电气起火：断电，用合适灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small electrical fire, the power switched off first, a carbon dioxide extinguisher, water crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电气起火先断电，不用水，报告。

shots.scene: 电流表测电流，单位安培
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an analog meter with a needle and a small current arrow flowing through a wire. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表测电流，单位安培，也叫安培表。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在断电电路板上串入电流表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands connecting an ammeter in series into a powered off training circuit board, the wire passing through the meter.
shots.narration: 电流表要串联，电流全部从表里过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter symbol with a very small resistor icon inside, the circuit current almost unchanged. No text.
shots.narration: 内阻做得很小，压降小，不影响电路。

shots.scene: 导线要能通过回路电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick wire to the ammeter in the main loop and a thin wire overheating crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表在主回路，导线要通得过电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wires of several thicknesses with a current rating chart icon, the right one checked. No text.
shots.narration: 粗细按回路电流和实验室规定选。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter with two leads touching both ends of a resistor. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表测两点间的电压。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电板上把电压表并在元件两端
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands connecting a voltmeter across both ends of a resistor on a powered off training board.
shots.narration: 并联在被测元件两端，测电压降。

shots.scene: 内阻很大，几乎不分电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter with a very large resistor icon inside, only a tiny current trickling through it. No text.
shots.narration: 内阻很大，几乎不分走电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple circuit with an ammeter in series and a voltmeter in parallel, both checked. No text.
shots.narration: 记住：电流表串，电压表并。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two meter dials, one with a straight line symbol and one with a wave symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 表盘直线是直流，波浪是交流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving coil meter between magnet poles, a direct current battery icon checked. No text.
shots.narration: 磁电式也叫动圈式，只测直流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving iron meter with a wave symbol highlighted and a small battery icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 动铁式交直流都能测，多用于交流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an analog needle meter next to a digital meter with a blank display. No text.
shots.narration: 按显示，分模拟式和数字式。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双量程表的公共端和量程端
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing at the common terminal and then at one of two range terminals on a dual range analog meter.
shots.narration: 双量程表：公共端固定，另一端选量程。

shots.scene: 大量程看上刻度，小量程看下刻度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter dial with an upper scale and a lower scale, arrows from the two range terminals to each scale. No text.
shots.narration: 接哪个量程，就读对应的刻度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reading the wrong scale with a confused face, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 很多人读错刻度，现在就要分清。

shots.scene: 【实拍】万用表旋钮拨到最大量程
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning the rotary dial of a digital multimeter to the highest range position, probes not connected.
shots.narration: 不知道大小，先用最大量程。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power off icon, then the range dial stepping down one position at a time. No text.
shots.narration: 断开后换挡，再逐步换到合适量程。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a needle hitting the end stop and a needle swinging backward, both with a power off hand. No text.
shots.narration: 指针打满或反偏，立即断电检查。

shots.scene: 电流表并到电源上等于短路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter placed directly across a power source, a spark and burn icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表绝不能并在电源两端，等于短路。

shots.scene: 电流挡电阻挡不能测电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter dial on the current and resistance positions touching a voltage source, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电流挡、电阻挡，不能去测电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a resistance measurement on a circuit with the power switch clearly off, a live circuit version crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 测电阻一定先断电，绝不带电测。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wattmeter dial, a real power icon checked and a reactive power icon not measured. No text.
shots.narration: 功率表测有功功率，不测无功。

shots.scene: 电流线圈串，电压线圈并
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside a wattmeter, a thick current coil in series with the load and a thin voltage coil across the supply. No text.
shots.narration: 电流线圈串联，电压线圈并联。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current arrow and a voltage arrow combining into a power icon on the dial. No text.
shots.narration: 两个线圈共同作用，读出功率。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wattmeter with four terminals, two for the current coil and two for the voltage coil, two marked with a star. No text.
shots.narration: 功率表四个端子：电流两个，电压两个。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand fitting a short metal link between the two star marked terminals of a wattmeter on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 标星号的同名端，按说明书短接。

shots.scene: 按需要选电压电流量程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wattmeter with a voltage range selector and a current range selector, both set by a hand. No text.
shots.narration: 电压、电流量程，按实验需要选。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dial reading in divisions multiplied by a constant to give the real power. No text.
shots.narration: 先算功率表常数，格数乘常数是功率。

shots.scene: 单位功率因数与低功率因数表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two wattmeters side by side, one marked with a full circle icon and one with a small arc icon. No text.
shots.narration: 功率表分单位功率因数和低功率因数。

shots.scene: 按负载功率因数选，选错不准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a load icon with a power factor gauge pointing to the matching wattmeter, a wrong pairing crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按负载功率因数和说明书选，错了不准。

shots.scene: 串电流表监视电流线圈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter in series with the wattmeter current coil, a needle below the limit line. No text.
shots.narration: 再串一只电流表，防电流线圈过载。

shots.scene: 一只表测电压、电流、电阻
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter in the center with icons for voltage, current and resistance around it. No text.
shots.narration: 万用表一表多用：电压、电流、电阻。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an analog multimeter and a digital multimeter side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 分指针式和数字式两种。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a red probe and a black probe leading from a multimeter to two points of a circuit. No text.
shots.narration: 通过两根表笔接入电路。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top of a digital multimeter with a blank display, a hold button and a power button highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 上面是显示屏、保持键和电源键。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotary dial with icons for voltage, current, resistance and continuity positions. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮选挡：电压、电流、电阻、通断。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the continuity position testing a disconnected wire on an unpowered bench, a beep icon. No text.
shots.narration: 通断挡能查导线通不通，要断电测。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the jacks of a multimeter with a separate high current jack highlighted, a wrong plug crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 大电流有单独的插孔，别插错。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sine wave with a flat dashed line marking its effective value and a meter reading. No text.
shots.narration: 仪表读到的是有效值。

shots.scene: 峰值是有效值乘根号二
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sine wave peak marked above the effective value line, a multiply by root two icon. No text.
shots.narration: 正弦峰值是有效值乘根号二，约1.414倍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sine wave labeled by icons with a peak far above the meter reading. No text.
shots.narration: 220伏交流，峰值约311伏。

shots.scene: 【实拍】检查表笔绝缘有无破损
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand bending and inspecting the insulation of multimeter test leads, the probes not connected to anything.
shots.narration: 用表前，查表笔导线有没有破损。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked probe and a broken meter case crossed out, a new probe set checked. No text.
shots.narration: 破了裂了就换；表壳破了，停止使用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding a probe with fingers behind the finger guard ring, a finger on the metal tip crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手指放在护指环后面，别碰金属部分。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: probes plugged into the current jack while measuring voltage, a spark icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 插电流孔去测电压会短路，先核对。

shots.scene: 换挡前表笔先离开电路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the probes lifted off the circuit before the dial is turned, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 换挡前，表笔先离开电路。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dial set, jacks checked with a magnifier, then the probes back on the circuit. No text.
shots.narration: 换好挡、核对好，再去测。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning a digital multimeter dial to the off position and coiling the test leads.
shots.narration: 用完拨到关机挡，防止下次误测。

shots.scene: 断电接线，查后通电，不带电改线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power off switch, a teacher check icon and a crossed out live rewiring hand. No text.
shots.narration: 断电接线，老师查后通电，不带电改。

shots.scene: 电流表串，电压表并，量程从大到小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter in series, a voltmeter in parallel and a range dial at maximum, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表串，电压表并，量程先大后小。

shots.scene: 测电阻断电，冒烟立即断电报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ohm symbol with a power off icon and a smoke wisp with a report arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 测电阻先断电；冒烟发烫，断电报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一台调压器和一把剥线钳
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a variable autotransformer with a round knob and a pair of wire strippers, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：调压器、常用器件与电工工具。
